title: 第11章 淬体四层第12章 小冲突
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 不知不觉，太阳已经升至高空，虽然此处悬崖背光，但是孙冰还是感觉到一阵炎热，可即便是在这样的条件下，他依旧一动不动，静静的探寻自己肉身的奥秘。
毕竟此刻的孙冰已经淬体三层巅峰了，只差一步就能够突破至淬体四层，虽然仅仅一个境界之差，其中却代表着淬体境前期与中期，一个拥有气感，一个没有，可以说天差地别。
而刚刚被淬炼过的身体格外的敏感，这也是最好的时机，纵然孙冰没有前辈师傅的指导，却也知道不能浪费这犹如黄金一般的时间。
当孙冰的精神全部都集中到一块的时候，就感觉到自己的体内似乎有种淡淡的疼痒，这种感觉似乎是从骨髓中迸发出来的，就算是想要阻止，却也没有丝毫办法。
当然了，这点点异常丝毫不被孙冰放在眼里，最让他兴奋的还是在这种又麻又疼又痒的情况下，他的身体素质竟然有了显着的提高。
这种感觉让孙冰格外的惊喜，因为他明白，淬体三层到四层最大的界限就是那一道气感，而神州大陆，就算是普通的凡人都知道，气感需要将自己的身体锻炼到当前境界的极限，然后从骨髓中迸发出来。
所以此刻孙冰已经有了这样的预兆了，也就代表着他即将要突破淬体四层了。
在得知了这个消息之后，孙冰心中相当振奋，不由得立刻操练起来，这个时候进行锻炼，对于身体的增幅是最大的，若是运道够好，在锻炼之时气感横生，那么就能够一举突破境界了。
对于剑客而言，锻炼身体并不是简简单单的举重锤炼，这些都是炼体修士才需要做的，剑客的肉身虽然强横，但却远远不及炼体修士，可若要问攻击力，那么首屈一指。
因为剑客身上的每一寸肌肉都是为了挥剑而生，每一剑都能够调动浑身的力道，这样才能够发出远超同境界的招式，这也是为什么同境界之中，剑客的攻击力最强。
而剑客锻炼身体最好的办法莫过于演练剑法了，这不仅能够加深自己对于剑法的理解，而且还能够让自己的肌肉熟悉剑法，从而做到今后挥剑动作熟练无比。
远远望去就能看见悬崖之上一名少年正在认真的练习剑法，悬崖旁白云隐约可见，时不时还有飞鸟嘶鸣，当真可以算是一处好地方。
而孙冰现在心神集中，丝毫没有在意周边的环境，每一招练习完毕，都能够感觉自己的身体增强了一分，这种变强的感觉让他都不愿意放下手中的木剑。
一遍，两遍，三遍……
不知不觉过去了整整半日，孙冰甚至连午饭都没有食用，全凭借顽强的毅力在支撑，身上那件青衫已经被汗水淋湿，甚至脚下的地板都有一些水迹，可想而知其中的辛苦。
但孙冰依旧没有任何放弃，因为他知道，一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭，若是今天这大好时机不能够突破的话，那么下一次突破不知道又在何时了。
纵然身体的力量已经逐渐枯竭了，可骨髓之中隐隐还能带来一点补充，若不然的话，孙冰早就累趴下了。
突然间，孙冰那平淡的面容上微微皱眉，却又有着止不住的狂喜：“要突破了。”
因为他清楚的感觉到，随着刚才最后一剑的挥出，骨髓中竟然爆发出一股难以忍受的疼痛。
这股剧烈的疼痛比之刚刚服用淬体丹更甚，而且伴随着深入骨髓的疼痛，体内的骨骼也在缓缓的增强，变得更加坚韧，原先因为练剑而消失的力气，也在逐渐恢复。
最主要的是，持剑的右臂中竟然隐隐有一股暖流，而这股暖流孙冰竟然能够完全操纵，顿时他就明白了，这就是突破淬体四层的那一道气感了。
剧痛来的迅速，去的可并不缓慢，整整一炷香的时间，孙冰也在那悬崖上站了一炷香的时间，这才缓缓褪去。
随着疼痛的消失，孙冰睁开了那双紧闭着的眼睛，此时他的眼眸更加漆黑，同样的眼神更加坚韧，这一次的突破让他对于未来更有信心。
轻轻活动了一下身体，一阵噼里啪啦的声音便从体内传出，直到此刻，孙冰才真正感觉到自己的身体变强了很多，这其中的差距甚至比从凡人到淬体一层还要大。
但是虽然身体强度增加了，可孙冰的外表依旧没有变什么样子，一点都不像什么肌肉狰狞的大汉，反倒是如同小白脸一样，不过只有孙冰自己才知道，这看似不起眼的身体中，蕴含了更加强大的力量。
一番活动之后，孙冰一套无比熟练的《纵剑诀》施展开来，木剑划破空气的声音在悬崖上回荡，可是其中的力道却比原来更胜。
“一剑夺命”
同样的一招使出来，只见木剑之上隐隐约约有一道剑光闪过，足足一丈开外的闪避上竟然出现了一个黑黝黝的窟窿，明显就是刚刚那一道剑光所致。
“这难道就是剑气么？威力竟然这么大。”
对于自己的杰作，孙冰颇有些目瞪口呆，他也没有想到，自己刚刚突破淬体境四层竟然已经有如此的实力了，要知道剑气只有沉溺剑法多年的人才能够施展开来，没有想到现在的孙冰已经能够使用了。
虽然一道剑气过后，右臂中的那一道气已经消失，就连身体都有些无力，但孙冰还是有一种难以抑制的惊喜。
要知道这一招对于整个淬体境的人来说，都有着不小的杀伤力，算是一个绝招了，就算是孙龙前来了，若是没有防备，都有可能因此而身受重伤。
只不过这一招对于目前的孙冰来说，消耗还是太大了，除非是生死危机，不然不能够轻易动用，否则将会成为案板上的肉。
但孙冰坚信，只要自己能够继续突破，那么根本就不需要担心消耗的问题，淬体境四层只不过拥有一道气感罢了，若是五层呢？六层呢？
甚至于淬体境巅峰，打通了浑身的经脉，那时候体内的真气一定更加多，完全不需要担心这点消耗，若是能够突破至练气境界，这样的一招剑气只能算是随手一击罢了。
一想到这里，孙冰的眼中不由得露出火热，在落云镇，练气境的高手，就算是三大家族的人都不能够忽视，而拥有了练气丹的孙冰，不知不觉已经抹除了其中最大的阻碍。
只要平平安安的突破到淬体境巅峰，那么练气可期。
“咕咕”
还没有等孙冰在那里畅想未来，肚子突然间传来了一阵叫声，这让他有些尴尬，再一看此刻的时间，太阳甚至已经下山了，这也就是说，孙冰已经整整一天都没有吃东西了。
随着时间的推移，修士终究能够达到辟谷的境界，但那对于孙冰来说，还是一个遥不可及的梦想，此刻境界低位，还是需要大量的食物补充，不然还没有修炼成为高手，自己就先饿死了。
当即，孙冰稍微收拾了一会，原先放在棚顶中的丹药自然需要贴身收藏，就算这处悬崖再怎么僻静，无人知晓，但这种珍贵的东西还是放在自己身上最保险了。
确认自己没有丝毫遗留之后，孙冰这才缓缓的走下山崖，现在正是晚餐时间，由于今天早上敲诈了秦管事一个竹杠，再加上今天还突破了，算是双喜临门，孙冰的心情也相当不错，倒也不在苛刻，直接朝着落云镇的酒楼走去。
content_en:
Unknowingly, the sun had risen high into the sky. Although the cliff was backlit, Sun Bing still felt a burst of heat. But even under such conditions, he remained motionless, quietly exploring the mysteries of his body.
After all, Sun Bing has reached the peak of the third level of Body Tempering at this moment, and is only one step away from breaking through to the fourth level of Body Tempering. Although the difference is only one level, it represents the early and middle stages of the Body Tempering Realm. One has the sense of Qi and the other does not. It can be said that there is a huge difference.
The body that had just been tempered was particularly sensitive, so this was also the best time. Even though Sun Bing did not have the guidance of his senior master, he knew not to waste this golden time.
When Sun Bing concentrated all his energy, he felt a faint itch in his body. This feeling seemed to burst out from his bone marrow. Even if he wanted to stop it, there was nothing he could do.
Of course, this little abnormality was not taken seriously by Sun Bing at all. What excited him the most was that despite this numbness, pain and itching, his physical fitness had improved significantly.
This feeling made Sun Bing particularly surprised, because he understood that the biggest boundary between the third and fourth levels of body tempering was the sense of energy. In China, even ordinary mortals knew that sense of energy required training one's body to the limit of the current state, and then bursting out from the bone marrow.
So at this moment, Sun Bing already has such a sign, which means that he is about to break through the fourth level of body tempering.
After learning the news, Sun Bing was very excited and couldn't help but start practicing immediately. Exercising at this time will have the greatest impact on the body. If you are lucky enough and feel energetic during exercise, you can break through the realm in one fell swoop.
For a swordsman, exercising is not just a matter of lifting weights. These are all things that a body-refining monk needs to do. Although a swordsman's physical body is powerful, it is far inferior to that of a body-refining monk, but if you ask about attack power, it is second to none.
Because every inch of muscle on the swordsman's body is made for swinging the sword, and each sword can mobilize all the strength of the body, so that he can perform moves that far exceed those of the same realm. This is why the swordsman has the strongest attack power among the same realm.
The best way for a swordsman to exercise is to practice swordsmanship. This can not only deepen his understanding of swordsmanship, but also make his muscles familiar with swordsmanship, so that he can be extremely proficient in sword swings in the future.
Looking from a distance, you can see a young man practicing his sword skills seriously on the cliff. White clouds are vaguely visible next to the cliff, and there are birds chirping from time to time. It can really be regarded as a good place.
Sun Bing was now focused and didn't care about the surrounding environment at all. After practicing each move, he could feel his body getting stronger. This feeling of becoming stronger made him unwilling to put down the wooden sword in his hand.
Once, twice, three times...
Unconsciously, half a day passed. Sun Bing didn't even eat lunch. He relied on his tenacious perseverance to support himself. The green shirt on his body was soaked with sweat, and there were even some water stains on the floor under his feet. You can imagine the hard work.
But Sun Bing still didn't give up at all, because he knew that if he can't make a breakthrough at this great opportunity, he doesn't know when the next breakthrough will be.
Even though the body's strength has gradually dried up, the bone marrow can still bring a little supplement. Otherwise, Sun Bing would have collapsed from exhaustion.
Suddenly, Sun Bing's plain face frowned slightly, but there was unstoppable ecstasy: "We are about to break through."
Because he clearly felt that with the last swing of the sword, an unbearable pain broke out in his bone marrow.
This severe pain was worse than the pain that had just taken the Body Tempering Pill, and along with the pain that penetrated into the bone marrow, the bones in the body were slowly strengthening and becoming tougher. The strength that had disappeared due to sword practice was also gradually restored.
The most important thing was that there was a faint warm current in the right arm holding the sword, and Sun Bing was able to completely control this warm current. He immediately understood that this was the aura that broke through the fourth level of the tempered body.
The severe pain came quickly but did not go away slowly. It took Sun Bing a whole stick of incense to stand on the cliff before it slowly faded away.
As the pain disappeared, Sun Bing opened his closed eyes. At this time, his eyes were darker and his eyes were tougher. This breakthrough made him more confident about the future.
After moving his body slightly, a crackling sound came from his body. It was only at this moment that Sun Bing truly felt that his body had become much stronger. The difference was even greater than that from a mortal to the first level of Body Tempering.
But even though his physical strength has increased, Sun Bing's appearance still hasn't changed. He doesn't look like a muscular and ferocious man at all. Instead, he looks like a pretty boy. However, only Sun Bing himself knows that this seemingly inconspicuous body contains more powerful power.
After some activities, Sun Bing performed an extremely skilled "Long Sword Technique". The sound of the wooden sword cutting through the air echoed on the cliff, but the power was stronger than before.
"One sword kills"
The same move was used, and a faint sword light flashed across the wooden sword, and a dark hole appeared in the dodge a full foot away, which was obviously caused by the sword light just now.
"Is this sword energy? It's so powerful."
Sun Bing was quite stunned by his masterpiece. He did not expect that he would already have such strength just after breaking through the fourth level of the body tempering realm. You must know that only those who have been addicted to swordsmanship for many years can use sword energy. He did not expect that Sun Bing could already use it now.
Although after the sword energy passed, the energy in his right arm had disappeared, and even his body was a little weak, Sun Bing still had an uncontrollable surprise.
You must know that this move has considerable lethality for the entire Body Tempering Realm people. It is considered a unique move. Even if Sun Long comes, if he is not prepared, he may be seriously injured.
However, this move is still too expensive for the current Sun Bing. Unless it is a life and death crisis, it cannot be used easily, otherwise it will become meat on the chopping board.
But Sun Bing firmly believes that as long as he can continue to break through, there is no need to worry about consumption. The fourth level of the body tempering realm only has a sense of energy. What if it is the fifth level? What about the sixth floor?
Even at the peak of the body tempering realm, with the meridians all over the body opened, there must be more true energy in the body at that time, and there is no need to worry about this consumption. If one can break through to the realm of qi training, such a move of sword energy can only be regarded as a casual strike.
When he thought of this, Sun Bing's eyes couldn't help but show fire. In Luoyun Town, even the masters of the Qi training realm, even the three major families, could not ignore them. Sun Bing, who had the Qi training pill, had unknowingly eliminated the biggest obstacle.
As long as you can safely break through to the peak of the body quenching realm, you can expect to practice qi.
"Cuckoo"
Before Sun Bing could think about the future, his stomach suddenly growled, which made him a little embarrassed. Looking at the time, the sun had even set, which meant that Sun Bing had not eaten for a whole day.
As time goes by, the monks will eventually be able to reach the realm of fasting, but that is still an unattainable dream for Sun Bing. At this low level, he still needs a lot of food supplements, otherwise he will starve to death before he can become a master.
Immediately, Sun Bing tidied up for a while. The pills originally placed on the roof of the shed naturally needed to be kept close to him. No matter how secluded the cliff was and no one knew about it, it was safest to keep such precious things with him.
After confirming that he had nothing left behind, Sun Bing slowly walked down the cliff. It was now dinner time. Since he blackmailed Manager Qin this morning and had a breakthrough today, it was a double blessing. Sun Bing was in a good mood, not harsh at all, and walked directly towards the restaurant in Luoyun Town.
title_en: Chapter 11 The Fourth Level of Tempering Body Chapter 12 Small Conflict
